meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划自动跑完,并行分工并留存每一步执行证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有写好的工作计划,想让多个子任务并行落地并留下记录。
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan end to end with parallel subtasks and recorded evidence.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a written work plan and want its subtasks run in parallel.

howto.what: Claude 会作为编排者执行 .omo/plans 下的 ulw-plan 工作计划:自己不改代码,把实现、测试、QA 逐项派给子代理并行处理,并维护计划勾选与证据记录,直到顶层勾选全部完成。
howto.when: 当你说 “ulw-execute”、“start work”,或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划时触发;若当时没有可选的计划,它会先调用 ulw-plan 生成计划再执行。

say.note: 读取 .omo/plans,选定计划并开始执行

say.text: 运行 .omo/plans 里的 <计划名> 计划
say.note: 选定该计划,派子代理并行开工
执行并跟进 PR,直到合并后清理

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an orchestrator for a ulw-plan plan in .omo/plans: it writes no code, delegates implementation, test, and QA to parallel subagents, and keeps checkboxes and evidence until top-level boxes are done.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say “ulw-execute” or “start work”, or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans; if no plan is selectable, it first invokes ulw-plan to generate one.

say_en.note: Reads .omo/plans, picks a plan and starts
Selects that plan and fans out subagents
Executes and follows the PR until merged
